1.text: Bene Data, kwizera kwanyu mwizera Umwami wacu Yesu Kristo w'icyubahiro, ntikube uko kurobanura abantu ku butoni.

2.text: Nihagira umuntu uza mu iteraniro ryanyu yambaye impeta y'izahabu n'imyenda y'akataraboneka, akinjirana n'umukene wambaye ubushwambagara,

3.text: namwe mukita ku uwambaye imyenda y'akataraboneka mukamubwira muti “Mwicare aha heza”, naho wa mukene mukamubwira muti “Wehoho hagarara iriya cyangwa wicare munsi y'agatebe k'ibirenge byanjye”,

4.text: mbese iyo mugenje mutyo ntimuba mwirobanuye, mukaba abacamanza batekereza ibidakwiriye?

5.text: Nimwumve bene Data bakundwa, mbese Imana ntiyatoranyirije abakene b'iby'isi ngo babe ari bo baba abatunzi mu byo kwizera, baragwe ubwami yasezeranije abayikunda?

6.text: Ariko dore mwebweho mwasuzuguye umukene. Mbese ye, abatunzi si bo babatwaza igitugu, bakabakurubanira mu nkiko?

7.text: Si bo batuka rya zina ryiza mwitirirwa?

8.text: Nyamara niba musohoza amategeko y'Umwami wacu, nk'uko byanditswe ngo “Ukunde mugenzi wawe nk'uko wikunda”, muba mukoze neza.

9.text: Ariko niba murobanura abantu ku butoni muba mukoze icyaha, mutsinzwe n'amategeko y'uko mwacumuye.

10.text: Umuntu wese witondera amategeko yose agasitara kuri rimwe, aba ayacumuye yose

11.text: kuko uwavuze ati “Ntugasambane”, ni we wavuze ati “Ntukice.” Nuko rero nudasambana ariko ukica, uba ucumuye amategeko yose.

12.text: Muvuge kandi mukore nk'abajya gucirwa urubanza n'amategeko atera umudendezo,

13.text: kuko utagira imbabazi atazababarirwa mu rubanza, nyamara imbabazi ziruta urubanza zikarwishima hejuru.

14.text: Mbese bene Data, byavura iki niba umuntu avuga yuko afite kwizera, nyamara akaba ari nta mirimo akora? Bene uko kwizera kwabasha kumukiza?

15.text: Cyangwa se, hagira mwene Data w'umugabo cyangwa w'umugore wambaye ubusa, kandi akaba abuze ibyokurya by'iminsi yose,

16.text: maze umwe muri mwe akamubwira ati “Genda amahoro ususuruke uhage”, ariko ntimumuhe ibyo umubiri ukennye byavura iki?

17.text: Uko ni ko no kwizera iyo kudafite imirimo, ahubwo kuri konyine kuba gupfuye.

18.text: Ahari umuntu yazavuga ati “Wehoho ufite kwizera, jyeweho mfite imirimo.” Nyereka kwizera kwawe kutagira imirimo, nanjye ndakwereka kwizera kwanjye kugaragazwa n'imirimo yanjye.

19.text: Wizera yuko Imana ari imwe rukumbi. Ibyo ni byiza, ariko abadayimoni na bo barabyizera bagahinda imishyitsi.

20.text: Wa muntu utagira umumaro we, ntuzi yuko kwizera kutagira imirimo ari impfabusa?

21.text: Mbese sogokuruza Aburahamu ntiyatsindishirijwe n'imirimo, ubwo yatangaga Isaka umwana we ngo atambwe ku gicaniro?

22.text: Ubonye yuko kwizera kwafatanije n'imirimo ye, kandi ko kwizera kwe kwatunganijwe rwose n'imirimo ye.

23.text: Ni cyo cyatumye ibyanditswe bisohora, bya bindi bivuga ngo “Aburahamu yizeye Imana bimuhwanirizwa no gukiranuka”, yitwa incuti y'Imana.

24.text: Mubonye yuko umuntu atsindishirizwa n'imirimo, adatsindishirizwa no kwizera gusa.

25.text: Dore na maraya uwo Rahabu. Mbese ntiyatsindishirijwe n'imirimo ubwo yacumbikiraga za ntumwa, akaziyobora indi nzira?

26.text: Nuko rero nk'uko umubiri udafite umwuka uba upfuye, ni ko no kwizera kudafite imirimo kumeze, kuba gupfuye.
